The '''''Toranni''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Toranni'' transported an Imperial exploration team to the newly-discovered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]], in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. On arrival on the world, the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] landed on a small atoll and two of the ''Toranni''{{'s}} crew&mdash;[[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Kinard]] and Private [[Tracher]]&mdash;disembarked from the vessel. Soon after, the vessel was approached by a group of [[Anguilla]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Alluuvia, and the Imperials opened fire on the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] and massacred them.
